items.title: TCLBANKER Malware Targets Users Through Self-Propagating WhatsApp and Outlook Worm Modules
items.description: A highly sophisticated Brazilian banking trojan named TCLBANKER, tracked under the campaign REF3076, this malware represents a major update to the older Maverick and SORVEPOTEL families. It stands out because it uses a fake, signed Logitech installer to infect systems and spreads automatically via WhatsApp and Microsoft Outlook.
